# ferentin_llm_provider (Data Source)

Look up an entry in the global LLM provider catalog by slug. Read-only.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Catalog slug (`anthropic`, `openai`, `google-vertex`, …).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `slug`. Surfaced as `id` for Terraform convention.
- `name` (String) Display name from the catalog.
